description:
In Redmine (already open in Firefox), log in as admin (Username: admin, Password: Admin1234!) and close the issue titled 'SSL certificate for api.devlabs.io expires in 14 days' (in the 'Infrastructure & DevOps' project).

The issue is currently in 'Resolved' status. You need to set it to 'Closed'.

Steps:
1. Log in with admin / Admin1234!
2. You will be on the issue page for 'SSL certificate for api.devlabs.io expires in 14 days'
3. Change the Status field to 'Closed'
4. Add a note: 'Certificate renewed successfully. Auto-renewal cron verified working. Monitoring alert added for 30-day expiry warning.'
5. Submit the update

Do not change any other fields.
